name: web
description: Search the web with domain filters and fetch public pages for focused AI-assisted answers.

configSchema.label: Search provider
configSchema.hint: Which service powers WebSearch. Automatic uses Tavily when its key is set, otherwise Serper.

configSchema.label: Tavily API key
configSchema.hint: app.tavily.com — powers WebSearch. Without a key here or in Serper only WebFetch works.

configSchema.label: Serper API key
configSchema.hint: serper.dev — Google results for WebSearch. Without a key here or in Tavily only WebFetch works.

configSchema.label: Documentation hosts
configSchema.hint: WebFetch returns pages from these hosts as Markdown instead of summarizing them through a model; a page too large to stay in context is summarized anyway. Exact host names, or "*.example.com" for every subdomain. This does not widen network access: DNS validation, address checks and redirect rules apply to every host equally. The summarizing step is also what frames page text as untrusted data, so list only published documentation, never hosts that serve user-submitted content.
